## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Find saved items across all of the user's boards by words in their text, author, link or the user's note. Returns the board and each item's ref for get_board_item.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | Yes | Words to find, like an author, topic or phrase. Min length 2. Max length 200. |
